https://github.com/passagemath/passagemath publishes 69 instantly pip-installable Python packages that together provide the full functionality of SageMath and can be installed separately for accessing specific functionality. Binary wheels are available on PyPI for Linux and macOS, both for x86_64 and ARM.

  • Like Sage, the passagemath fork ships and provides interfaces to a wide range of computer algebra, exact mathematical computation, and symbolics software packages developed over the past 50 years, including Singular, GAP, Maxima, FriCAS, SymPy, FLINT, PARI/GP, and many more.

passagemath is the product of a 5-year modularization effort that has resolved the impracticality of deployment of Sage stemming from its monolithic design.

I am reaching out to the Lean/mathlib community to suggest that passagemath may be the ideal middleware to connect to state-of-the-art computer algebra / exact mathematical computation software (and the related communities).

Details and discussions: #general > passagemath
